buy_title: If you buy one bidet this year, make it this one
buy_total: The button is a paid link: as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay. Prices in this guide were reported between November 2025 and October 2026 (the NEO 185 was $45.99 on Amazon on December 2, 2025, per camelcamelcamel) and move with sales; the button shows today's.

cards.name: LUXE Bidet NEO 185 (dual nozzle, non-electric)
cards.badge: Our first pick · the best value for most homes
cards.price: About $46–$50 when we checked ($49.99 list at LUXE)
cards.buy_if: you want the cleanest result per dollar: a rear nozzle and a separate feminine nozzle, self-cleaning, no electricity, on the seat you already own.
cards.skip_if: the thought of cool water is a deal-breaker (get the NEO 320, which mixes in hot water from the sink), or your toilet's bolt spacing is outside about 5.5–7.5 inches.
cards.owners: About 40,000 Amazon ratings, 79% of them five stars and 3% one or two stars (Amazon's review page, search snapshots, October 2026); 4.9 stars on about 8,200 Walmart reviews.

buy.pick: The standard NEO 185 (the 185 Plus costs a few dollars more); knob colour is cosmetic. A T-adapter and supply hose come in the box.
buy.check: Sold by Luxe Shop or Amazon; measure your seat-bolt spacing (about 5.5 in is standard) and the room behind the bolts; register with LUXE for six extra months of warranty.
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: KOHLER PureWash M100 (dual-wand attachment)
cards.price: About $59–$75 at the time of writing (Lowe's $59.98, Wayfair $65.88, Home Depot $74.96; $99.95 list)
cards.buy_if: you want a KOHLER part on a KOHLER toilet, with front and rear wands, and you catch it near $60.
cards.skip_if: you want the most evidence: it has about 50 reviews at Home Depot (4.0 stars) against the NEO 185's roughly 40,000 Amazon ratings.
cards.owners: 4.0 stars across about 50 Home Depot reviews (79% would recommend) and 3.9 on about 540 Amazon.ca ratings; owners praise the pressure, and some report overspray and leaks at the handle.
cards.cta_label: Check the PureWash M100 on Amazon

cards.name: KOHLER PureWash M300 (manual bidet seat)
cards.badge: A whole new seat, still no outlet
cards.price: About $93–$110 at the time of writing (Costco $99.99 online; Wayfair $109.98)
cards.buy_if: your old seat is worn out anyway and you want the bidet hidden inside a quiet-close KOHLER seat.
cards.skip_if: your toilet is round: the US M300 is elongated only (the round M350 is sold in India).
cards.owners: 4.3 stars on Kohler.com (91 reviews), Lowe's (132) and Wayfair (77); owners like the seat and the easy install, and some find the spray weak and the opening small.
cards.cta_label: Check the PureWash M300 on Amazon

cards.name: LUXE Bidet NEO 120 (single nozzle)
cards.badge: Cheapest good one · Amazon's No. 1 best-selling attachment
cards.price: About $34–$40 at the time of writing ($39.99 list; $33.97 in a past Prime Day window)
cards.buy_if: you want to try a bidet for the price of two months of toilet paper and only need a rear wash.
cards.skip_if: anyone in the house wants a front wash: the NEO 185 adds that nozzle for about $10 more.
cards.owners: 4.6 stars across about 84,000 Amazon ratings and the No. 1 spot in Amazon's Bidet Attachments best sellers; 4.7 stars on Best Buy, where 96% of 354 reviewers recommend it. Bob Vila calls it the best bang for the buck.

cards.name: LUXE Bidet NEO 320 (warm water, non-electric)
cards.badge: Warm water without an outlet · a Consumer Reports favourite
cards.price: About $60–$69 at the time of writing ($59.99 list; the NEO 320 Plus runs $65.99–$68.99)
cards.buy_if: cool water is the one thing stopping you, and the sink is within about 9–10 feet of the toilet so a hot line can reach.
cards.skip_if: you don't want a hose running from the vanity, or a hole drilled in it.
cards.owners: 4.9 stars on about 16,500 reviews at LUXE and about 3,100 at Walmart; Consumer Reports names the NEO 320 Plus its top budget pick and Reviewed calls it the most comfortable attachment it tried.

cards.name: TUSHY Classic 3.0
cards.price: About $97–$129 at the time of writing ($129 at TUSHY; $114.95 at Walmart; $97 in a past Amazon deal)
cards.buy_if: the feel of the stream matters more than price: it is the attachment professional testers pick most often.
cards.skip_if: you want a separate front nozzle or a long, simple return window (TUSHY's policy is store credit on unopened returns within 30 days, per its help center).
cards.owners: 4.5 stars on more than 19,000 Walmart reviews (listings pool colours); CNN Underscored, Forbes, Rolling Stone and Popular Science each name it their best attachment.
cards.cta_label: Check the TUSHY Classic 3.0 on Amazon

cards.name: Brondell Swash EcoSeat (manual bidet seat)
cards.price: About $90 at the time of writing ($89.98 in Amazon's best-seller list)
cards.buy_if: you want a manual bidet seat from a bidet specialist with the biggest review base in its class.
cards.skip_if: you would rather keep your current seat (an attachment does the same job for half the price).
cards.owners: No. 1 in Amazon's Bidet Seats best sellers, with 4.3 stars on about 10,900 ratings (search snapshot, 2026).
cards.cta_label: Check the Swash EcoSeat on Amazon

cards.name: SmartBidet SB-1000 (electric seat)
cards.badge: Warm water, heated seat, dryer, under $300
cards.price: About $280 at the time of writing ($279.99 on Amazon on May 20, 2026, list $379.99)
cards.buy_if: you want the full heated-seat experience for the least money and already have an outlet within about 4 feet of the toilet.
cards.skip_if: there is no outlet near the toilet: adding a GFCI outlet typically costs $130–$300 (Angi, 2026).
cards.owners: 4.5 stars on about 3,000 Amazon ratings and 4.7 on 428 Home Depot reviews.

cards.name: TOTO Washlet S2 (electric seat)
cards.badge: The premium seat testers rate highest
cards.price: About $420 at the time of writing (Amazon best-seller list and Home Depot)
cards.buy_if: you want the most comfortable stream and dryer CNN Underscored tested, with endless warm water.
cards.skip_if: you are on a budget or have no outlet nearby; the TOTO C2 and C5 it replaced in 2025 are discontinued, so check you are buying the S2.
cards.owners: No. 4 in Amazon's Bidet Seats best sellers; CNN Underscored's best bidet seat of 2026 after testing 35 bidets.
cards.cta_label: Check the Washlet S2 on Amazon

cards.name: Bio Bidet BB-2000 Bliss (electric seat)
cards.price: About $390–$550 at the time of writing ($389.98 Amazon low on June 25, 2026; $549 list)
cards.buy_if: you want a feature-rich electric seat with a full 3-year warranty and you can wait for a sale.
cards.skip_if: you would pay full price: it has sold for $390–$450 on Amazon at past events.
cards.owners: 4.7 stars on 770 Home Depot reviews (95% recommend); Forbes Vetted's best bidet overall for 2026. One owner reports ten years of use before the heater failed.
